author: Ricardo Marques
description: Recipe search, ingredient matching, nutrition filters and a private cookbook for any AI agent.
name: ask.recipes

prompts.name: cook_what_i_have
prompts.title: Cook with what I have
prompts.description: Turn the ingredients on hand into a ranked list of recipes, with what each one is missing.

arguments.name: ingredients
arguments.description: What is in the fridge or pantry, comma separated.

arguments.name: minutes
arguments.description: Most time you want to spend, total.

prompts.name: dinner_tonight
prompts.title: Dinner tonight
prompts.description: Pick a well-rated dinner for tonight within a time, serving and diet constraint.

arguments.name: minutes
arguments.description: Most time you want to spend, total.

arguments.name: diet
arguments.description: Any constraint: vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, nut-free.

resources.name: docs
resources.title: ask.recipes docs
resources.description: How to connect, what to ask, what each tool does, defaults and support.

tools.name: add_to_pantry
tools.title: Add to the pantry
tools.description: Add or restock pantry items from what the user says in passing: "bought rice and two chickens", "here's what's in the fridge". An item already in the pantry gets the new quantity. Names are matched loosely, so 'Eggs' and 'eggs' are the same item. Returns the whole pantry after the change.

add.description: items to add or update; an item already in the pantry gets the new quantity

quantity.description: optional amount in the user's words, e.g. '6', '500 g', 'half a bag'
optional amount in the user's words, e.g. '6', '500 g', 'half a bag'

tools.name: connect_cookidoo
tools.title: Connect Cookidoo (Thermomix / Bimby)
tools.description: Check whether the user's Cookidoo account (the Thermomix / Bimby recipe platform) is connected, and when it is not, return a one-time link where they enter their Cookidoo login. For "connect my Thermomix", "link my Bimby", or before the first send_to_thermomix. Give the user the link; it works once and expires in 15 minutes.

devices.description: every Thermomix paired with the account

language.description: language of the Cookidoo account; write everything sent to it in this language

machine.description: Thermomix model the recipes are written for

tools.name: cooked_history
tools.title: What the user cooked
tools.description: List what the user cooked and when, newest first, for "what did we cook last week", "when did I last make the lasagna", "what have we been eating". Call it before planning a week so the plan avoids repeating recent dishes and ingredients. Each entry carries the day, the user's note and the recipe summary with its source link. Without since, until or recipe_id it covers the last 30 days.

recipe_id.description: only entries for this recipe, for 'when did I last make the lasagna'; lifts the 30-day default

since.description: first day to include as YYYY-MM-DD; without since, until or recipe_id the last 30 days are returned

until.description: last day to include as YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive

tools.name: create_cookbook
tools.title: Create a cookbook
tools.description: Create an empty cookbook, for "make me a BBQ cookbook". Not needed before save_recipe, which creates a cookbook it does not know. Fails when a cookbook with that name exists already.

description.description: one line on what goes in it

tools.name: delete_cookbook
tools.title: Delete a cookbook
tools.description: Delete a cookbook by name. No recipe is lost: any recipe that was only in this cookbook moves to the default cookbook. The default cookbook cannot be deleted.

cookbook.description: name of the cookbook to delete; its recipes are kept and any that were in no other cookbook move to the default one

tools.name: disconnect_cookidoo
tools.title: Disconnect Cookidoo
tools.description: Remove the user's stored Cookidoo login from ask.recipes. Recipes already sent to Cookidoo and recipes imported into ask.recipes stay where they are.

tools.name: find_by_ingredients
tools.title: Find recipes by ingredients on hand
tools.description: Find recipes that use ingredients the user already has: leftovers, a full fridge, an ingredient about to turn. Ranks by how many of those ingredients a recipe uses and how few extra ones it needs. The user's pantry counts as on hand too, so a recipe that only needs pantry staples on top of what was passed ranks as nearly complete; with no ingredients passed it cooks from the pantry alone, for "what can I make with what I have". Takes the same diet, nutrition and exclude_ingredients filters as search_recipes. Each result links to its source. The user's profile, when set in the app, excludes allergens and dislikes, keeps its diets on and supplies the default time budget; pass max_total_minutes=-1 to lift it.

batch_friendly.description: true to leave out dishes cooked per portion, for a crowd; recipes not yet classified stay in

dairy_free.description: only recipes without milk, butter, cheese, cream or yogurt

exclude_ingredients.description: ingredients to leave out for this search, whole-word match on the ingredient list, e.g. ['chicken','brussels sprouts'] to avoid repeating what the week already has; nuts, gluten and dairy as a word apply the matching diet filter; the profile's allergens and dislikes stay excluded on top

feeding.description: how many people are eating, e.g. 10 for a dinner party; from six up, dishes cooked in one vessel (stews, braises, tray bakes, casseroles, soups, roasts) rank ahead of dishes cooked per portion (steaks, burgers, pancakes, stir-fries); nothing is excluded

gluten_free.description: only recipes without wheat, barley, rye, oats or products made from them

ignore_pantry.description: true to match only the ingredients passed and not count the pantry, for 'using just these'

ingredients.description: ingredients to cook with, e.g. ['oats','milk','eggs','skyr','berries']; leave empty to cook from the pantry alone

max_calories.description: only recipes with at most this many calories per serving, e.g. 300

max_carbs_g.description: maximum grams of carbohydrates per serving

max_fat_g.description: maximum grams of fat per serving

max_sugar_g.description: maximum grams of sugar per serving

min_calories.description: only recipes with at least this many calories per serving

min_fiber_g.description: minimum grams of fiber per serving

min_protein_g.description: minimum grams of protein per serving, e.g. 10

min_rating.description: only recipes the source rates at least this many stars; off unless passed

min_reviews.description: only recipes with at least this many source ratings; off unless passed

nut_free.description: only recipes without tree nuts or peanuts; coconut counts as nut-free

query.description: optional free-text to narrow results, e.g. 'breakfast pancakes'

vegan.description: only vegan recipes: vegetarian and no eggs, dairy or honey

vegetarian.description: only vegetarian recipes: no meat, poultry, fish, seafood or gelatin in the ingredients

annotations.title: Find recipes by ingredients on hand

tools.name: get_pantry
tools.title: What is in the pantry
tools.description: List what the user has told you is in their kitchen: pantry, fridge and freezer, with quantities when they gave one. For "what do I have", before suggesting a shopping list, or to check an ingredient before recommending a recipe. find_by_ingredients with no ingredients searches from this list directly.

quantity.description: optional amount in the user's words, e.g. '6', '500 g', 'half a bag'

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.title: Get a recipe in full
tools.description: Get one recipe in full: ingredients, step-by-step instructions, times, yield, nutrition and its source link. For when the user picks a recipe from a search or asks how to make it. Pass servings to scale the ingredient quantities, e.g. for meal prep or a crowd; nutrition_for says whether the nutrition numbers are per serving or for the whole yield.

id.description: recipe id from a previous search

servings.description: scale ingredient quantities to this many servings; only works when the recipe's yield states servings, nutrition stays per serving

tools.name: import_cookidoo_recipe
tools.title: Import a Cookidoo recipe
tools.description: Copy one Cookidoo recipe into the user's private ask.recipes collection, so the agent can read it in full, adapt it, build a shopping list, or compare it with other recipes. Imported recipes are visible only to this user and cannot be shared. Importing the same recipe again refreshes the copy.

cookidoo_id.description: Cookidoo recipe id such as r123456 or a created-recipe id, from search_cookidoo, list_cookidoo_recipes or the recipe's Cookidoo URL

tools.name: list_cookbooks
tools.title: List cookbooks
tools.description: List the user's cookbooks with how many recipes each holds, for "what cookbooks do I have", or before saving when the user says "the usual one". Every user has a default cookbook; the others are named by the user, e.g. Stews, BBQ, Christmas.

tools.name: list_cookidoo_recipes
tools.title: List the user's own Cookidoo recipes
tools.description: List the recipes the user created on Cookidoo, including ones sent there by send_to_thermomix, for "what is on my Bimby", "my Thermomix recipes", "read recipes from my Cookidoo". This is the Bimby side; list_saved is the ask.recipes side. Returns Cookidoo ids to pass to import_cookidoo_recipe. Names and links only until the user imports one.

annotations.title: List the user's own Cookidoo recipes

tools.name: list_saved
tools.title: List saved recipes
tools.description: List the recipes the user saved in ask.recipes, for "my recipes", "what did I save", "what's in my Stews cookbook". Each recipe lists the cookbooks it is in and the user's note; pass cookbook to see one cookbook only. Each also carries when it was last cooked and how many times, when mark_cooked recorded it. Not the Thermomix / Bimby / Cookidoo side; that is list_cookidoo_recipes.

cookbook.description: only recipes in this cookbook, by name; leave empty for every saved recipe, each listed with the cookbooks it is in

tools.name: mark_cooked
tools.title: Mark a recipe as cooked
tools.description: Record that the user cooked a recipe, for "we made that tonight", "cooked the curry yesterday", "the lasagna was a hit". One entry per time it was cooked, with the day and an optional note on how it went. Pass date when the user names a day other than today. The recipe need not be saved. Returns the entry plus how many times and when this recipe was last cooked.

date.description: the day it was cooked as YYYY-MM-DD in the user's calendar, e.g. yesterday's date for 'we made it last night'; empty means today

note.description: what the user said about how it went, e.g. 'kids loved it, double the sauce next time'; at most 200 characters

tools.name: remove_from_pantry
tools.title: Remove from the pantry
tools.description: Take items out of the pantry for "used the last onions", "we're out of milk", or empty it with all=true when the user lists what is in the kitchen now, then add_to_pantry. Names are matched loosely. Returns the whole pantry after the change.

all.description: true to empty the pantry, for 'here is what's in my kitchen now' before add_to_pantry

remove.description: item names to take out, for 'used the last onions', 'we're out of milk'

quantity.description: optional amount in the user's words, e.g. '6', '500 g', 'half a bag'

tools.name: save_recipe
tools.title: Save a recipe
tools.description: Save a recipe to one of the user's cookbooks, for "save that one", "keep this", "put it in my BBQ cookbook". Pass cookbook when the user names one; it is created on first use. Without one the recipe goes to the default cookbook. A recipe can sit in several cookbooks; saving it again to the same one only updates the note.

cookbook.description: cookbook to save into, by name, e.g. 'Stews' or 'Christmas'; created when it does not exist yet; leave empty for the default cookbook

note.description: the user's own note on this recipe in this cookbook, e.g. 'half the chilli, kids loved it'

tools.name: search_cookidoo
tools.title: Search the user's Cookidoo
tools.description: Search Cookidoo's catalogue of Thermomix recipes through the user's connected account, for "find a Bimby recipe for", "what does Cookidoo have for", "search my Bimby for". For the user's own recipes use list_cookidoo_recipes. Returns Cookidoo ids to pass to import_cookidoo_recipe. Cookidoo recipes are the user's subscription content: never quote them beyond name and link unless the user imports them.

query.description: dish or ingredients to look for in Cookidoo's own recipes, in the user's Cookidoo language

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.title: Search recipes
tools.description: Search human-rated recipes for a what-to-cook or what-to-eat question: dinner tonight, cooking for guests, a quick weeknight meal, a protein or calorie target, macros for a cut or a bulk, meal prep for the week. Every result links to its source. Filters by time, rating, review count, diet (vegetarian, vegan, gluten_free, dairy_free, nut_free, judged from the ingredient list) and nutrition (calories, protein, fat, carbs, sugar, fiber per serving as reported by the source). A nutrition filter only returns recipes whose yield is stated in servings, so the numbers are per serving; recipes without nutrition data are excluded. Results rank by how many people rated them; min_rating and min_reviews cut below a threshold only when passed. exclude_ingredients leaves out recipes using any of the ingredients named, for building a week without repeats. The user's profile, when they set one in the app, applies on top: allergens and dislikes are always excluded, its diets are always on, and its time budget is the default when max_total_minutes is not passed; pass max_total_minutes=-1 to lift it.

batch_friendly.description: true to leave out dishes cooked per portion, for a crowd; recipes not yet classified stay in

dairy_free.description: only recipes without milk, butter, cheese, cream or yogurt

exclude_ingredients.description: ingredients to leave out for this search, whole-word match on the ingredient list, e.g. ['chicken','brussels sprouts'] to avoid repeating what the week already has; nuts, gluten and dairy as a word apply the matching diet filter; the profile's allergens and dislikes stay excluded on top

feeding.description: how many people are eating, e.g. 10 for a dinner party; from six up, dishes cooked in one vessel (stews, braises, tray bakes, casseroles, soups, roasts) rank ahead of dishes cooked per portion (steaks, burgers, pancakes, stir-fries); nothing is excluded

gluten_free.description: only recipes without wheat, barley, rye, oats or products made from them

max_calories.description: only recipes with at most this many calories per serving, e.g. 300

max_carbs_g.description: maximum grams of carbohydrates per serving

max_fat_g.description: maximum grams of fat per serving

max_sugar_g.description: maximum grams of sugar per serving

max_total_minutes.description: only recipes taking at most this many minutes total

min_calories.description: only recipes with at least this many calories per serving

min_fiber_g.description: minimum grams of fiber per serving

min_protein_g.description: minimum grams of protein per serving, e.g. 10

min_rating.description: only recipes the source rates at least this many stars, e.g. 4.5; off unless passed

min_reviews.description: only recipes with at least this many source ratings, e.g. 25; off unless passed

nut_free.description: only recipes without tree nuts or peanuts; coconut counts as nut-free

query.description: the dish or main ingredients, e.g. 'overnight oats' or 'chicken curry'; express time, rating and nutrition limits with the filters rather than in words

site.description: restrict to one source site slug, e.g. budgetbytes

vegan.description: only vegan recipes: vegetarian and no eggs, dairy or honey

vegetarian.description: only vegetarian recipes: no meat, poultry, fish, seafood or gelatin in the ingredients

tools.name: send_to_thermomix
tools.title: Send a recipe to the Thermomix
tools.description: Send one recipe to the user's Cookidoo account as a private created recipe, so it shows on their Thermomix / Bimby with guided cooking. For "send this to my Thermomix", "put it on my Bimby", "cook this on the TM6". First get_recipe, then rewrite the recipe for the Cookidoo account: name, ingredients and steps in the account's language (connect_cookidoo returns it), amounts in grams and millilitres since the Thermomix weighs everything, steps as Thermomix steps with time, temperature, speed, direction or mode. Pass name, ingredients and steps; show the user the rewritten steps before sending. Each call creates a new Cookidoo recipe. Thermomix step settings, for rewriting a recipe before send_to_thermomix: each step is one action with at most one setting block. Times are seconds. Chop: 5-10 s / speed 5-7. Sauté onion and garlic: 3-5 min / 120 °C / speed 1. Simmer sauces and soups: 15-25 min / 100 °C / speed 1, with direction CCW when pieces must stay whole. Blend soup: 1 min / speed 10. Whip cream: speed 3.5 with the butterfly, write that in the text. Melt chocolate: 50 °C / speed 2. Knead bread: mode dough for 2-3 min. Steam: mode steaming, or varoma temperature with the Varoma dish. Rice: mode rice_cooker. Modes depend on the model connect_cookidoo reports: a TM31 has none, a TM5 only dough and turbo, TM6 and TM7 all of them; on an older model write the step with time, temperature and speed instead, and the server refuses a mode the machine lacks. Keep the ingredient amounts in the step text so the screen shows them. Steps without settings are fine for prep done outside the machine.

hints.description: optional tips shown under the recipe on Cookidoo

id.description: recipe id from a search, get_recipe, list_saved or upload

ingredients.description: one ingredient per entry in the account's language with metric amounts in g or ml, e.g. '200 g cebola, em pedaços'; the stored list is sent verbatim when omitted

machine.description: TM31, TM5, TM6 or TM7, only when the user names a paired machine other than the connected one

name.description: recipe name in the Cookidoo account's language; the stored name is used when omitted

steps.description: the recipe rewritten as Thermomix steps with settings, in the account's language; when omitted the recipe's plain steps are sent without settings

direction.description: CCW for reverse blade (keeps pieces whole: stews, rice, fish); omit for normal

mode.description: guided mode instead of manual settings: dough, browning, turbo, steaming, blend, warm_up, rice_cooker

speed.description: one of soft 0.5 1 1.5 2 2.5 3 3.5 4 4.5 5 5.5 6 6.5 7 7.5 8 8.5 9 9.5 10; soft is the gentle stirring speed

text.description: the step as the cook reads it on the Thermomix screen; one action per step. Settings are appended as a Cookidoo label such as 5 min/100°C/vel 1, so leave them out of the text

time_seconds.description: run time in seconds for this step, e.g. 300 for 5 min

annotations.title: Send a recipe to the Thermomix

tools.name: share_recipe
tools.title: Create a share link
tools.description: Create a share link for one of the user's uploaded recipes, for "send this to my wife", "share it with Tom", "give me a link", "add this to MacroFactor". Returns a share.ask.recipes URL that opens without an account and is not listed or indexed; the page credits the recipe's original source and carries schema.org Recipe markup, so apps that import a recipe from a link can read it. Only recipes the user uploaded can be shared; for other recipes the source link is the thing to share.

id.description: id of a recipe the user uploaded

tools.name: unsave_recipe
tools.title: Remove a saved recipe
tools.description: Take a recipe out of the user's cookbooks, for "remove that from my saved", "take it out of Christmas". With cookbook set it leaves only that cookbook; without it the recipe is removed from every cookbook. The recipe itself stays searchable.

cookbook.description: take it out of this cookbook only; leave empty to remove it from every cookbook

tools.name: update_cookbook
tools.title: Rename or describe a cookbook
tools.description: Rename a cookbook or change its description, for "call it Sunday Roasts instead". Recipes stay where they are.

cookbook.description: current name of the cookbook to change

description.description: new description; leave empty to keep it

name.description: new name; leave empty to keep it

tools.name: upload_recipe
tools.title: Upload a private recipe
tools.description: Add a recipe the user supplies themselves: pasted in, dictated, a family recipe they want kept, or a web page they point at. For a web page, pass the page's raw HTML or its JSON-LD as markup together with source_url; the server extracts the facts. Each call creates a new private recipe, visible only to this user in searches and saves.

ingredients.description: one ingredient per entry, with quantities, e.g. '2 cups rolled oats'

markup.description: for a recipe from a web page: the page's raw HTML, or just its schema.org/Recipe JSON-LD block, as fetched by the agent; the server extracts name, ingredients, steps, times, nutrition and rating from it, so the other fields can stay empty

name.description: recipe name; may be left empty when markup carries the recipe

source_url.description: the web page the recipe came from, if any; kept as attribution on the private copy
